summary: V4.4 Phase A+B / Iter16 — XP system + Atelier tab. Backend: 12/12 new pytest pass (XP suggest structure + weights, GM-only suggest, commit persistence + xp_log audit, negative-amount correction, convert reduces unspent and raises total_points, convert>unspent → 400, atelier GET/PUT/continuity, player-view safety subset only, player 403 on PUT and /continuity). Frontend smoke verified end-to-end on the live preview: tab-atelier visible to admin → session-zero+arcs+master-plot panels render, atelier-save / continuity / add-arc buttons present, atelier-continuity-btn click produced atelier-findings panel with the 'NobodyWhoExists' missing_node info card (text confirmed). Session 6 → open-xp-btn visible to admin → XP modal opens with xp-panel-overlay + xp-scorecard-table + xp-commit-btn + 3 xp-total-{cid} cells (one per published PC).

minor.issue: Per main-agent note: the admin reset _GAME_COLLECTIONS list does NOT include the new 'atelier' collection. Arcs are tied to campaign_id so they get orphaned on each reset (a fresh GET /api/atelier/{cid} always returns the 'empty' state because atelier docs are upserted lazily, but stale atelier docs from a previous campaign_id linger in Mongo). Recommend adding 'atelier' to the wipe list in routes/admin.py.

integration_issues.issue: Could not auto-confirm in this run because clicking 'text=Eli' on the Characters tab navigated to /genesis (the locator matched a different 'Eli' element on the page rather than the Eli character card). The badge component is wired in CharacterSheet.jsx and the underlying data is present (xp_total≥2.5 / xp_unspent reduced after convert verified via GET /api/characters/{cid}/xp in pytest). Main agent can self-verify by clicking the Eli character card avatar/name link explicitly.

action_items: Optional: add 'atelier' to admin reset-to-evereantha _GAME_COLLECTIONS wipe list (routes/admin.py) so stale Atelier docs are cleared on reset.
Self-verify CharacterSheet sheet-xp-badge in browser: navigate to /app/characters/{eli_id} after a fresh reset+commit; expect 'XP X.XX earned · Y.YY unspent'.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/xp.py: WEIGHTS dict matches the user-choice spec (chat_ic 0.05 > chat_ooc 0.01, dice_macro 0.10, journal 0.25, spotlight 0.50). Bonus is correctly capped at +2.0 per session and floored at 0. Commit persists base/bonus/amount in a single xp_log row source='session_baseline' — clean audit trail.

routes/xp.py convert_xp_to_cp: uses int(round(amount)) for total_points but float for xp_unspent — fine, but spec says 'floor(amount)'. round(2)=2 matches floor for whole numbers; for 2.6 it'd round up to 3 instead of floor 2. If exact floor semantics matter for fractional XP→CP, switch to math.floor.

routes/atelier.py replace_atelier: stamps ids on arcs/beats but `continuity_findings` is preserved across PUT — good (so a save doesn't blow away findings). However, PUT also overwrites `continuity_checked_at` indirectly via no-op; safe.

routes/atelier.py continuity check: 'dead_alive_conflict' branch only reads first 300 chars of node.content for the literal 'dead' substring — this is a deliberate V4.4 simple heuristic per the docstring; will produce false-positives for content that says 'not dead' or 'half-dead'. Acceptable for V4.4; revisit when Phase C wires Claude.

Player-view of GET /api/atelier/{cid} correctly strips arcs / expectations / character_integration / recurring_themes — only safety subset (lines, veils, safety_tools, schedule, table_contract) is exposed. Verified test_player_view_returns_safety_subset_only.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (atelier tab + session-XP modal end-to-end verified; sheet-xp-badge selector not exercised due to wrong navigation target — see action items)

rca of the issue: No bugs blocking V4.4 Phase A+B sign-off. The single non-blocker is the admin reset's _GAME_COLLECTIONS list missing 'atelier' (already flagged by main agent in the misc-info note). Frontend selector for sheet-xp-badge wasn't directly verified due to a Playwright locator collision on 'Eli' text — the underlying XP data round-trip (commit → xp_total/xp_unspent in GET /characters/{cid}/xp) is fully verified server-side, so the badge should render correctly when CharacterSheet mounts.
